description: This file defines an Android activity called NotificationsActivity that manages the UI for displaying notifications in an online shopping platform. It includes setup for a RecyclerView, swipe actions, refresh management, and interaction with a notifications repository.

classes.name: NotificationsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity responsible for displaying, refreshing, and managing user notifications, including swipe actions and sticky headers.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, observes data flows, and manages user interactions.

methods.name: buildRows
methods.description: Builds a list of UI rows from notification items grouped by time buckets.

methods.name: setupStickyHeaders
methods.description: Sets up decoration for sticky section headers in the RecyclerView.

methods.name: setupSwipeActions
methods.description: Configures swipe gestures for notifications including mark read and dismiss with undo.

methods.name: setupRecyclerAnimations
methods.description: Configures item animations for the RecyclerView.
